en.1: Fig. 1. Derivation of instruction examples and construction of the training set. a, The 13 corpus-derived tasks and two glossary tasks yield 392,871 examples. The paired node tasks ask for a label to be read from XML or assigned in context. POS targets include punctuation, and syntactic targets include function-word positions. b, The fixed 1,200 test records contain 1,100 distinct sentence texts. These match 1,381 source records. Excluding all matches leaves 3,635 records from which the corpus-derived training tasks are regenerated. The four training files contain 15,742 examples.
en.2: Fig. 2. From annotated structures to instruction targets. a, Grammatical decisions represented in human annotations. b, Spans, labels and attributes in the reference XML provide the evidence for each task. Rules derive local single-core structures. c, Clause-, word- and constituent-level tasks supervise individual analyses. In the main task, templates express these analyses in a fixed order and pair them with the reference XML. The training set combines these corpus-derived examples with the two glossary tasks.
en.3: Fig. 3. Task sizes in the complete instruction resource and the training set. a, Full collection (392,871 examples, logarithmic axis). b, Training set (15,742 examples, linear axis). After exclusion of all source records matching test sentence texts, the training set comprises 3,635 whole-sentence examples, 1,000 examples from each of 12 corpus-derived auxiliary tasks, and 54 and 53 glossary examples. Bar labels give counts. Task IDs follow Tables 3–5.
en.4: Fig. 4. Access to the study materials and reconstruction of the training set. a, Zenodo distributes the instruction files, GitHub provides the code and validation outputs, and LDC distributes the source treebank. b, The main-task XML yields the 5,016 sentence–XML pairs. The selection index identifies the 1,200 test records in order. Excluding all 1,381 records whose texts match the test sample leaves 3,635 for task generation. The training set combines the resulting main-task examples, sampled auxiliary examples and 107 glossary examples.
en.5: Fig. 5. Target-response length distributions and supervision formats. a, Length quantile intervals for the output field of each task. Horizontal line endpoints indicate the 10th and 90th percentiles, colored boxes span the 25th to 75th percentiles, and dark vertical lines indicate medians; median values are listed on the right. The sentence-level main task is highlighted in orange. Lengths are measured in Unicode code points, the horizontal axis is logarithmic, and quantiles use linear interpolation. b, Of the 392,871 instruction examples in the complete resource, 210,049 contain an explanation before the answer (53.47%) and 182,822 use direct answers (46.53%). The intervals describe the length distributions of target responses.
en.6: Fig. 6. Structural-attribute distributions in sentence-level target XML. a, The eight scp values and their occurrence counts. V denotes a predicate-core configuration without an object or complement, and VOCC denotes a combination of a predicate core, an object, and two complements. b, Frequencies of the eight raw fun values, with uppercase and lowercase values retained separately. c, The ten most frequent mod patterns and their corresponding relation categories; “-” denotes other lexical relations. Counts are based on the final XML of the 5,016 sentence-level main-task examples. Panels a and b use logarithmic horizontal axes, with values occurring once indicated by short lines and numbers; panel c uses a linear horizontal axis. The scp, fun, and mod attributes occur 17,240, 5,325, and 10,941 times, respectively. There are 593 mod patterns, and the ten most frequent account for 5,177 occurrences.
en.7: Fig. 7. Evaluation under six model and fine-tuning conditions. Qwen2.5 denotes Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3 denotes Qwen3-4B. “No task SFT” denotes no project-specific sentence-based task fine-tuning. Qwen3 is compared before and after SFT separately with thinking disabled and enabled. a, XML parsability rate. b, Proportion of outputs that are both XML-parsable and text-consistent with the original sentence. Both panels use all 1,200 inputs per condition as the denominator. c–e, Four F1 scores for Qwen2.5, Qwen3 with thinking disabled and Qwen3 with thinking enabled, respectively. The corresponding n values give parsable prediction counts before/after SFT: 831/1,116, 739/999 and 905/1,137. Text-inconsistent predictions remain in each F1 evaluation set. f, Exact-match rate of linear sentence-pattern expressions over all 1,200 inputs; outputs that cannot be compared count as nonmatches. Expressions are regenerated from reference and predicted XML before comparison. Gray bars show conditions without project-specific SFT; blue bars show conditions after SFT. Bar-end labels give percentages.

zh.1: 图1 标注整句派生指令样本及构建训练集的过程。a，13类语料派生任务与两类符号释义任务共生成392,871条样本。配对的节点任务分别要求解读XML标记或根据原句判断标签。词类目标含标点，句法目标含虚词位。b，固定的1,200条测试记录含1,100种不同整句文本，在源语料中匹配1,381条记录。全部排除后，从其余3,635条记录重新生成语料任务，四份训练文件合计15,742条样本。
zh.2: 图2 从人工标注结构到指令任务的目标答案。a，人工标注中记录的语法判断。b，参考XML中的片段、标签与属性提供各项分析的依据，单核结构由规则提取。c，小句、词和成分层面的辅助任务分别训练局部分析；整句主任务按固定顺序用模板表述这些判断，并给出参考XML。训练集由语料派生样本与两类符号问答共同构成。
zh.3: 图3 完整指令资源与训练集的任务规模。a，完整资源共392,871条，横轴为对数尺度。b，训练集共15,742条，横轴为线性尺度。排除与测试整句文本相同的全部源记录后，训练集包含3,635条整句主任务样本、12类语料派生辅助任务各1,000条样本及两类符号释义样本（54条、53条）。条末标出计数，任务编号见表3—5。
zh.4: 图4 研究材料的获取与训练集的重建。a，Zenodo提供指令文件，GitHub提供代码和评测输出，LDC提供原始树库。b，可从整句主任务的最终XML恢复5,016条原句与XML配对，并按抽样索引还原1,200条测试记录及其顺序。排除与测试整句文本匹配的1,381条记录后，从保留的3,635条记录重新生成任务。训练集包括所得整句主任务样本、抽取的辅助任务样本和107条符号问答。
zh.5: 图5 目标响应长度分布与监督形式。a，各任务output字段的长度分位区间：横线端点为第10和90百分位，色块覆盖第25至75百分位，深色竖线为中位数，右侧列出中位数。整句主任务用橙色突出。长度按Unicode码点统计，横轴为对数尺度，分位数采用线性插值。b，完整392,871条指令样本中，210,049条在答案前附有说明，占53.47%；182,822条采用直接回答，占46.53%。区间反映目标响应的长度分布。
zh.6: 图6 整句目标XML的结构属性分布。a，八种scp取值及其出现次数；V表示无宾补的谓核配置，VOCC表示谓核、宾语与双补语的组合。b，八种fun原始取值的频次，大写和小写分别保留。c，频次最高的十种mod模式及对应关系类别；“-”表示其他词法关系。统计对象为5,016条整句主任务的最终XML。a、b采用对数横轴，频次为1的项目以短线及数字标示；c采用线性横轴。scp、fun和mod分别出现17,240、5,325和10,941次；mod共有593种模式，前十种合计5,177次。
zh.7: 图7 六种模型与微调条件下的评价结果。Qwen2.5表示Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，Qwen3表示Qwen3-4B。“未SFT”表示未接受本项目的句本位任务微调。Qwen3分别在思考关闭和开启时比较SFT前后的表现。a，XML可解析率；b，XML可解析且文本与原句一致的输出比例。两个面板均以每种条件的全部1,200条输入为分母。c—e，依次为Qwen2.5、关闭思考的Qwen3、开启思考的Qwen3的四项F1；n依次给出SFT前后的可解析预测数，即831/1,116、739/999和905/1,137。各F1评价集均保留文本不一致的预测。f，全部1,200条输入的线性句式表达式完全匹配率，无法比较的输出计为未匹配；表达式从参考和预测XML重新转换后比较。灰色条表示未接受本项目SFT，蓝色条表示SFT后，条末标签为百分比。
